method: 68's part (height 20) plus a flat hem on the flange top edge: 180 deg bend, inner radius = hem gap 0.01, outer 2.51, about (y 2.51, z 20), folded toward +y (inside); hem leg 8 - (0.01 + 2.5) = 5.49: y 2.52..5.02, z 14.51..20; extrusion along x 100
